mapper.select: SELECT id, ticket_category_id, total_stock, available_stock, locked_stock, sold_stock, version, created_at, updated_at FROM ticket_stock WHERE ticket_category_id = #{ticketCategoryId}
SELECT id, ticket_category_id, total_stock, available_stock, locked_stock, sold_stock, version, created_at, updated_at FROM ticket_stock ORDER BY ticket_category_id ASC
SELECT id, ticket_category_id, total_stock, available_stock, locked_stock, sold_stock, version, created_at, updated_at FROM ticket_stock WHERE id > #{lastId} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_stock ( ticket_category_id, total_stock, available_stock, locked_stock, sold_stock, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{ticketCategoryId}, #{totalStock}, #{availableStock}, #{lockedStock}, #{soldStock}, COALESCE(#{version}, 0), #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_stock SET total_stock = #{availableStock}, available_stock = #{availableStock}, locked_stock = 0, sold_stock = 0, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE ticket_category_id = #{ticketCategoryId} AND locked_stock = 0 AND sold_stock = 0

UPDATE ticket_stock SET total_stock = total_stock + #{adjustQuantity}, available_stock = available_stock + #{adjustQuantity}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE ticket_category_id = #{ticketCategoryId} AND available_stock + #{adjustQuantity} >= 0 AND total_stock + #{adjustQuantity} >= locked_stock + sold_stock

UPDATE ticket_stock SET available_stock = available_stock - #{quantity}, locked_stock = locked_stock + #{quantity}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE ticket_category_id = #{ticketCategoryId} AND available_stock >= #{quantity}

UPDATE ticket_stock SET available_stock = available_stock + #{quantity}, locked_stock = locked_stock - #{quantity}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE ticket_category_id = #{ticketCategoryId} AND locked_stock >= #{quantity}

UPDATE ticket_stock SET locked_stock = locked_stock - #{quantity}, sold_stock = sold_stock + #{quantity}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE ticket_category_id = #{ticketCategoryId} AND locked_stock >= #{quantity}
